scene_source.split_unit: complete ReplicaCAD stage/layout family; no windows from a layout family cross train/validation

shared_camera.orientation: fixed; position and lookat receive the same translation

paths.geometric_rationale: move the camera and look direction 4 cm upward from a 1.55 m start while keeping orientation fixed; adds a distinct image-motion direction without leaving the registered room view

shared_variables: same scene assets and placement per layout family
same camera intrinsics, resolution and endpoint times
same event sensor and generator configurations as the paired path pilots
same physical depth, camera pose and interval flow labels for EventGenesis and V2E
selection_rule: execute every listed layout/path combination; do not filter by EventGenesis or V2E event counts, model outputs, or downstream scores
known_limits: all paths are camera-only; no independent object motion or dynamic occlusion is claimed
raw segmentation IDs are not mapped to physical link IDs
radiometric exposure and sensor calibration remain unverified
these six short trajectories are a pilot, not a formal training bank or domain-generalization result
